_README: Section 7 of the master prompt forbids inventing benchmarks. This file is the ONLY
source of reference values the report may use. If a variable has no entry here, the
report renders 'Individualized assessment required' for it. Nothing is inferred.
Every entry needs: value(s), units, population it applies to, evidence_class, and source.
literature          - a peer-reviewed study or federation technical manual, with citation
coaching_convention - a widely taught coaching target, NOT an empirical distribution
athlete_baseline    - computed from this athlete's own session, filled at runtime
SHIPPED EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Populating this is a sports-science task, not a coding task.
Add entries only when you can name the source. An entry with source set to null is
rejected by the S9 verifier and will block report publication.
